home.title: Welcome
home.intro: This is the first skeleton of the conference hall management system. Hall plans, events and bookings will be added step by step.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.message: An unexpected error occurred while processing your request. Please try again later.

auth.secure: Your connection is encrypted; your password is never stored in plain text.

staffLogin.title: Admin sign in
staffLogin.subtitle: Sign in with your organisation account to manage halls, events and sales.
staffLogin.forgot: If you forgot your password, contact your organisation's administrator.
staffLogin.visualTitle: Plan your hall down to the centimetre.
staffLogin.visualText: Floor-plan editor, events, prices and sales in one panel. Everyone sees only the sections they are allowed to.

customerLogin.title: Welcome back
customerLogin.subtitle: Sign in to see your tickets and pick your seat in seconds.
customerLogin.visualTitle: The best seat is waiting for you.
customerLogin.visualText: See the hall on the floor plan, choose your place; your ticket is ready in seconds.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Sign up in a minute and grab your seat quickly at the next event.
register.consent: I agree to my personal data being processed for ticketing (KVKK).
register.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
register.passwordShort: The password must be at least {0} characters.

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.intro: Sections granted to your role are shown as open. Sections will become available one by one.
admin.deniedTitle: You don't have access to this section
admin.deniedText: Your role does not include the permission this section needs. Ask your organisation's administrator for access.

manage.name: Events
manage.description: Create events and link them to a hall and plan version.

manage.description: Ticket prices, price groups and seat categories.
